Overview

Lucknow is a city in Uttar Pradesh with a population of 3,500,000. The capital of Uttar Pradesh, known for its Nawabi-era elegance, Mughal cuisine, intricate embroidery, and historic architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
